resolution: The bundle was regenerated by re-running data-raw/quantum_foundation_benchmark.R at HEAD with the unclamped edaphos_r2(). inst/extdata/quantum_foundation_cerrado.rds now holds 17 negative per-fold R2 values and zero exact zeros, where it previously held 17 exact zeros and no negatives; the run reproduces bit-for-bit from its seed. README.md and vignettes/pilar4-pilar6-quantum.Rmd were rewritten: the 'statistically indistinguishable' conclusion the clamp manufactured is replaced by the measured finding that all four methods, including the ranger baseline, fall below the null. The vignette's hand-typed '#>' console block -- indistinguishable from knitr output -- was replaced by a live chunk reading the bundle. tests/testthat/test-readme-numbers.R binds the table to the bundle and asserts no censored R2 survives.
